fields.title: Tab ID
fields.description: Unique identifier of the restaurant table tab.

fields.title: Restaurant table
fields.description: Selected restaurant table for which this tab was opened.

fields.title: Discount amount
fields.description: Optional monetary discount applied when settling the tab.

fields.title: Status
fields.description: Current operational status of the table tab.

subtotalAmount.description: Sum of the amounts for all non-cancelled items launched on this tab before any discount.

totalAmount.description: Amount due for this tab after applying the optional discount to the subtotal.

transitions.description: Closes a settled table tab after its payment has been recorded, freeing its table.
